notes.title: Patch 2025 was just released
notes.content:
Hey guys,

It's been a while since the last update of Casual Pixel Warrior - the casual top-down RPG-like wave shooter. So here it is!

One of the bigger additions is basically under the hood, but will repeatedly be revealed on certain events: the seasonal quests feature.

https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1807240/ss_0be4c6b1121d4fb29df67b165310e753b22c30c5.jpg?t=1745702358

The internal seasonal quest feature has been expanded so that it can now dynamically fetch various additional resources:


IEntity scripts
Graphical assets
Sound files
Properties


This allows way more rich-experienced seasonal events: Imagine your base being x-massy on christmas with christmas trees, snow and presents. Or a cool spooky quest on Halloween. Or an egg hunt on easter. Or anything else. All this is now possible!

https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1807240/ss_25306e4efb2556fdeda06522c2f2da0f335c0aa5.jpg?t=1745702358

Another thing - as part of a huge update decision across all my games - is that the game now uses windowed fullscreen! Thus you can now minimize the game or move out with your mouse. The game won't crash or hang anymore. This is an essential feature that plays an important role in the players experience.

https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1807240/ss_af3ee299541b11c2f951ab9f6040c6c629615297.jpg?t=1745702358

I also added coin and gem pick up sounds. Whenever you collect coins or gems, the game will now play an indicator sound. This makes the game even more interactive, providing a better gameplay experience.

https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1807240/ss_c8da98ac21cbf8ad7db171649718e564da2e03cd.jpg?t=1745702358

Also the loading screen has been improved a bit. Sure, there is still room for improvement, but it's a right step in the right direction.

Have fun with the update!

Kind Regards

notes.title: New Years Event
notes.content:
On December 31st, 2023 we will run a new years event, that gives you an opportunity to win 100 gems!

This is in order to thank you for playing Casual Pixel Warrior. It won't be pretty different to the christmas special event, altough it gives you a greater time frame to solve the quest!

What do you have to do?
- Collect 500 coins
- Frag 250 enemies

Do this in one match and then you can earn 100 gems!

We hope you are having great holidays and wish you a happy new year 2024!

We are also planning new updates for the next year and will inform you about that.

notes.title: August Summer Update 2023
notes.content:
Hey guys,

I've just published the August Summer Update 2023!

Here are the changes:

Show timer to indicate when daily quests reset
Distinctive save file: Player props are now bound to Steam Account
Greater damage for rocket launcher weapon
Hint text for when you already own a shop item
Mouse wheel support for shop and map selection menus
Fixed messed up positioning of collectible items in bottom left section
Pets now approach nearby food fast for a better feeding experience
More bugfixes and improvements


Have fun!

Kind Regards

notes.title: Gem Hunter Quest #001
notes.content:
Gem Hunter Quest #001 coming soon!

I am happy to announce the first in-game event for Casual Pixel Warrior!

In this event you will have to solve 3 tasks in order to get 10 gems!

The tasks are as follows:

Collect 300 coins
Frag 150 enemies
Do this with less than 65 dodges


You will have to do this task during the same match!

The event will take place on July 23th, 2023 from 6pm to 9pm EST.

Have fun!

Kind Regards

The game now offers you to do daily quests which will in turn reward you with coins and gems. These quests repeat each day.

notes.title: Pet feature is now live
notes.content:
Hey guys,

today I've published the pet feature. What does that mean exactly?

You can now obtain a dog from the shop that does the following:

When you are in your basis it drops a few coins every now and then
When you are in a match it drops 10-20 coins per minute in your basis which you can collect upon return


Because it is so helpful and a good boi, it is the most expensive purchasable item in the shop.

Have fun!

Kind regards

notes.title: Transitioned from EA to Fully Released
notes.content:
Hey guys,

the game has just been transitioned from Early Access to full release.

The decision has been made, because the foundation of the game is now done. Future updates will contain additional content such as new worlds or weapons/items. These will be included within the game in future updates. Of course bugfixes will be released, too, if found and reported.

Also an update has just been published providing the following changes:

Fixed that sometimes the player moves extremely fast right after the map has loaded
Fixed that some sounds are played at maximum volume even though the volume has been decreased
Improved gameplay of lavaland, adjusted alien wave handling and mothership health
Fixed that some bullets may collide with other bullets or the owner
Bugfixes and overall improvements


Have fun with the game!

notes.title: Big upgrade BETA version is live!
notes.content:
Hey guys,

a beta version of the current big upgrade is now live.

You can now play in the way it was announced before.

- Play endlessly in the given maps
- Collect coins
- Buy upgrades such as weapons, ammo and unlock new maps
- Post screenshots of your end game information to share how far you have come in a map!

Buying ammo has a temporary effect, so be sure to manage your expenses in a clever way.

There is still more content to come, so stay tuned for further upgrades.

Please report bugs with detailed descriptions in the discussion section.

Kind regards

notes.title: Big update coming soon!
notes.content:
Hey guys,

I have decided that Casual Pixel Warrior will change massively with the next update.

Before that the game was intended to just be iterative: You proceed from map to map and after you have finished all levels the game would be finished.

I figured that this is a bit boring. So I have decided to implement massive changes, so that gameplay will be as follows:
- Instead of proceeding from map to map, you can play each map whenever you want and the waves go infinitely
- This means playing a map is like a classic wave shooter: Defeat more and more waves and lead the leaderboards!
- Fragging enemies will, as currently is, drop some coins
- You can use these coins in the shop to buy upgrades: Ammo, weapons and more maps
- The better weapons you got / there more ammo you have the longer will you be able to last the waves. How long will you be able to last?

This massive change will ensure much more that the game has some replay value. Because basically it never ends.

After the release I will push more minor updates wich are planned to provide more weapons and maps.

So, stay tuned for the next BIG update!

Kind regards

PS: If you still like the old concept, you might want to check out Solitarius. It is planned to remain its gameplay style. The only difference is, that it is set in a sci-fi space environment.
